.github/workflows/example.yml:6:3  note  concurrency-cancel-on-push-main
  workflow cancels in-progress runs of a group keyed on github.ref in a workflow that deploys from the default branch; a second push cancels a half-finished deploy

  expression     github.ref   at :6  (group)
  triggers       push

  or in .jobsworth.yml:   rules: { concurrency-cancel-on-push-main: off }
